title: Ankhorage Google Play Deployment Provider
summary: Provides a Google Play deployment provider for Ankhorage application shipment.
purpose: Isolate Google Play deployment behavior behind a provider boundary.
responsibilities: Provide the Google Play deployment provider composition.
Adapt Google Play-specific deployment behavior to the deployment-provider boundary.
boundaries: Does not own deployment orchestration or cross-provider release policy.
Does not implement other deployment providers.
audience: Applications and deployment tooling that select a deployment provider.

architecture.role: An outbound deployment-provider adapter with an explicit composition entrypoint.
invariants: Google Play-specific behavior remains behind the provider boundary.

limitations: Only Google Play-backed deployment is provided.
